functions.name: OpponentProximityScanTeamRecognition
functions.summary: Per-frame opponent awareness update. Resets the 5 proximity slots and 5 team slots, then either registers the nearest vehicle (FindNearestVehicle) or scans every active vehicle (dword_7C54F0 list, bound by dword_5C329C) computing planar squared distance from self position, applying team/direction heuristics (sub_4C7BD0, 625.0 squared threshold, dword_7C56A4==7, lap comparison at +0x403C) that set an overtake target at +0x45FC and a direction sign at +0x4420, then sorted-inserts candidates into the 5-slot nearest list (distances at +0x41A8/+0x41EC/+0x4230/+0x4274/+0x42B8, vehicle ids at +0x4174/+0x41B8/+0x41FC/+0x4240/+0x4284). After the scan, matches each proximity slot's opponent team id (offset 0x4894) against the 5 team slots at +0x42D0, fills unused team slots, and consumes a one-shot flag at +0x4578 by re-seeding all team-slot distance fields to 500.0f.

operations.description: 5-iteration reset loop: for each proximity slot k (base this+0x4174+0x44*k): distance at +0x41A8 = 1232348144 (999999.0f), team flag at +0x42CC+0x1C*k = 0, slot id at +0x41B4 = -1, active flag at +0x4174 = 0.
v5 = FindNearestVehicle(this+0x4): query the nearest opponent vehicle given this vehicle's pointer.
If v5 nonzero: proximity slot 0 distance at +0x41A8 = 1065353216 (1.0f) and slot 0 id at +0x4174 = *v5 (nearest vehicle registered directly).
Else branch: scan i over [0, dword_5C329C) reading v7 = dword_7C54F0[i], the active vehicle pointer array.
Skip self: proceed only when this+0x0 (self vehicle id) != v7.
Read opponent world position (X at +0x34E0, Z at +0x34E8) and lap counter; subtract self position so v42/v43 hold deltas, then v41 = deltaZ*deltaZ + deltaX*deltaX (planar squared distance).
Proceed only when opponent lap counter (read at opponent +0x4550) is less than dword_5EA2CC (race-lap threshold).
sub_4C7BD0(v7): opponent team/class check; when it returns true, apply the recognition heuristics below.
Overtake-candidate gate: v41 < 625.0 && dword_7C56A4 == 7.
Proceed when opponent lap (at opponent +0x403C) exceeds self lap at this+0x403C (opponent is a lap ahead).
this+0x45FC = opponent pointer (overtake/target slot recorded).

Cross-product sign test: (oppZ - selfZ)*this+0x448C - (oppX - selfX)*this+0x4494; when <= 0.0 set this+0x4420 = -1071644672 (-1.0f) else 1075838976 (2.0f). Records on which side the opponent is for overtake direction.

Sorted insertion of the candidate into the 5-slot nearest list: distances at +0x41A8 (slot 0), +0x41EC (slot 1), +0x4230 (slot 2), +0x4274 (slot 3), +0x42B8 (slot 4) with matching vehicle ids at +0x4174, +0x41B8, +0x41FC, +0x4240, +0x4284; shift entries down and insert v41 / dword_7C54F0[i] at the first slot whose distance is larger. Uses F_2DVectorDirectionProjection on this+0x448C (heading vector) vs the candidate delta to gate whether the candidate is ahead (-5.5 threshold).

Team matching pass over the 5 proximity slots (base +0x4174, stride 0x44): for a slot with an active pointer and distance field < 999998.0, scan the 5 team slots at +0x42D0 (stride 0x1C) for a value equal to the opponent team id (read at opponent offset 0x4894).
When a matching team slot v30 is found: set the team flag at +0x42CC+v30*0x1C = 1 and store the team index v30 into the proximity slot id field at +0x41B4+0x44*k.

Team slot fill pass over the 5 proximity slots (base +0x41B4, stride 0x44): for a slot whose distance at +0x41A8 is <= 999998.0 and whose id at +0x41B4 is still -1, read the opponent team id at offset 0x4894 from the active pointer at +0x4174.
Guard (packet guard:0): distance at +0x41A8 <= 999998.0 && slot id at +0x41B4 == -1 (slot not yet assigned to a team).

Find the first free team slot v35 (flag at +0x42CC+0x1C*v35 is zero) and populate its fields: +0x42CC = 1 (matched flag), +0x42D0 = team id, +0x42DC = 0, plus the -971228160 (-1000.0f) and -1 sentinel fields of the team-slot block; then store v35 into the proximity slot id at +0x41B4+0x44*k.
Final one-shot: proceed when the byte at this+0x4578 is nonzero.
Consume the flag: this+0x4578 (byte) = 0.
5-iteration loop re-seeding each team slot's distance field at +0x42DC+0x1C*k to 1140457472 (500.0f).
Return the previous value of the one-shot flag byte at +0x4578.

unresolved: The outer guard on the sorted-insertion chain reads as `v41 >= farthest-slot OR heading projection >= -5.5` and yet the chain itself only inserts when v41 < a slot distance; the two conditions appear inverted and the true control flow is ambiguous (possible decompiler artifact).

Globals flt_59E440, flt_59E980, flt_59E984, flt_59E988 and unk_7CE2F0 are listed as read in the packet but do not appear in the raw source text; their roles are unknown (likely consumed inside callees such as F_2DVectorDirectionProjection).
Team-slot block includes sentinel fields at +0x42C8 and +0x42D8 (values -1 and -1000.0f) that are written but not listed as packet fields.
The owner object is unidentified; the structure matches the AI-driver context (proximity/team slots at +0x4174/+0x42CC) but the containing class is not proven.

functions.name: ParameterValueSetter
functions.summary: Sets the vehicle maxSpeed field (this+0x4538, CONFIRMED) from an int parameter. Parameter value 18 selects the idle/reverse speed target constant flt_8ACFB4; any other value is cast directly to float and stored. Called per frame from AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher (0x00424CD0), AIAbility (0x00429470) and CommandQueueResponseHandler (0x00429EE0). maxSpeed is recalculated every frame, so an external poke does not persist.

operations.description: Branch on the parameter value a2: the special idle-speed-target path is taken only when a2 == 18.
When a2 == 18: set maxSpeed at this+0x4538 to the idle/reverse speed target constant flt_8ACFB4 (read-only global).
Otherwise: set maxSpeed at this+0x4538 to the raw parameter value cast to float ((float)a2).

functions.name: SessionCleanupFlagClear
functions.summary: Per-frame session-active flag setter on an F1CVehicle. Reads the RetiredFlag byte at +0x4410; if the vehicle is not retired, clears the cleanup/disqualification flag at +0x4424 to 0 and sets +0x45F4 to 1 to mark the session active. Returns the original retired byte regardless of path.

operations.description: Read the RetiredFlag byte at +0x4410 into result.
If result is zero (not retired), write 0 to +0x4424 (cleanup/disqualification flag).
If result is zero, write byte 1 to +0x45F4 (AIControlFlag), marking the session active.
Return the saved retired byte (nonzero when the writes were skipped).

The semantics of +0x4424 (cleanup/disqualification flag) come from existing-analysis prose; packet evidence only shows the literal zeroing and the 1.0-byte write pattern.

functions.name: AIOvertakeDecision
functions.summary: AI overtake decision evaluated per frame from AISteering. Returns a3 (the candidate overtake direction value) when an overtake against the opponent vehicle a2 is accepted, otherwise 0. Bails out immediately during replay (ReplayAIStateCheck). Updates the shared max speed this+0x450C to max of own and opponent speed. Then gates by session type dword_7C56A4: for race (7) it compares lap numbers this+0x403C; for session 5 it runs ServerSessionGateCheck on both vehicles; for other types it requires the opponent to be losing (a2 best-lap this+0x409C < own). For session 7 it additionally requires the current overtake target this+0x45F8 to equal a2, checks the overtake-state dword at obj+0x48A8 (obj = *(this+0x0)) against the opponent's with this lap number > 3, and a pit/stop-state eligibility condition on both cars' obj fields. When accepted and this+0x3D6C != 2 (guard:0) and fuel-rate factor this+0x3984 > 0.001, it records the target this+0x45FC = a2 and sets the overtake speed offset this+0x4420 to +3.0 (a3 == 2) or -3.0.

operations.description: Replay gate: if ReplayAIStateCheck(this + 3) returns nonzero, return 0 immediately (no overtaking during replay).
Shared max speed: this+0x450C = max(this+0x450C, opponent speed a2+0x44C4).
Session-type gate on global dword_7C56A4: if != 7 and != 5, then if opponent best lap a2+0x409C >= own this+0x409C return 0 (opponent is not losing), else accept the overtake.
Session-5 gate: if dword_7C56A4 == 5, return 0 unless ServerSessionGateCheck(this) succeeds while ServerSessionGateCheck(a2) fails.

Session-7 lap comparison: if dword_7C56A4 == 7, v8 = this+0x403C (lap number); if opponent lap a2+0x403C > v8 accept the overtake unconditionally, otherwise fall through to the stricter target checks.
Target identity: if this+0x45F8 (current overtake target) != a2 return 0.
Overtake-state comparison: with v9 = *(this+0x0) as the object pointer, if obj+0x48A8 > opponent obj+0x48A8 AND this lap number v8 (this+0x403C) > 3, mark the candidate v4 = a3.

Pit/stop-state eligibility: a complex AND/OR condition over own obj (v9) and opponent obj (v7) dword/byte fields at +0xCD4/+0xD14/+0xD18/+0xD58 (own car in a stop-request state while opponent is not, or opponent flagged) marks the candidate v4 = a3. Offsets are read from the source but not individually enumerated in the packet field list.

Commit conditions: if v4 (candidate) is set AND this+0x3D6C != 2 (guard:0, car conditions) AND this+0x3984 (fuel-rate factor) > 0.001, then record this+0x45FC = a2 (new overtake target); if a3 == 2 set this+0x4420 = 3.0, else this+0x4420 = -3.0.
Return v4: the accepted candidate a3 when the overtake conditions hold, otherwise 0.

unresolved: Global flt_59E600 (0x0059E600) is read per the fact table but never appears as a named reference in the .c (FPU-folded into an instruction).

Several source offsets are not individually enumerated in the packet field list and are only covered by source:raw: the opponent speed field a2+0x44C4, the opponent lap/best-lap fields a2+0x403C and a2+0x409C, the opponent overtake state a2+0x48A8, and the pit/stop-state fields on both vehicles' object pointers at +0xCD4/+0xD14/+0xD18/+0xD58.

The exact meaning of the pit/stop-state AND/OR condition (which combination of the +0xCD4/+0xD14/+0xD18/+0xD58 flags permits an overtake) and the semantics of a3 (direction) are DERIVED from the fills, not proven by the .c.

functions.name: scaledValueIndexParser
functions.summary: Parses configuration tokens into a scaled pair of doubles and a clamped index. When trigger a3 is non-zero, extracts a value triplet, scales this+0x0 and this+0x8 by factor a5, stores an int truncation at this+0x10, then parses a final index at this+0x14 clamped to [0, this+0x10-1]. Shared setup-value helper used by per-wheel, fender, engine-map and vehicle-file sections.

operations.description: If a3 is non-zero, the token-triplet parse/scale path executes.
Parse token triplet: sub_565AA0(a3, this, this+8, &v12, 0) extracts two double values and a temporary int.
Convert the parsed temporary double v12 to int via CRTFtol (float-to-int truncation).
Scale first double at this+0x0 by a5 and store back; store converted int at this+0x10; scale second double at this+0x8 by a5.
Parse final index token: sub_565760(a4, this+0x14, 0, 0, 0) writes an int into this+0x14.
When parsed count v11 at this+0x10 > 0 and index at this+0x14 >= 0, clamp index into [0, v11-1]; otherwise force index to 0.
Write clamped or zeroed index back to this+0x14.
Return the final clamped index value.
Caller context: setup-value parser shared by PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader, FenderAeroSetupSectionReader, EngineMapSetupFieldDefinitions and TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

functions.name: UpdateTrackSetup
functions.summary: Per-frame vehicle setup update driven by component/subcomponent indices a2/a3. When a2 == -1 or a3 == -1 (all components) or a2 == 4 with a3 in 44..50, clamps the gear-selection indices in the 64-byte-stride table at this+0xBC4 (entries 44..50). Then, gated on the event-mode flag this+0x1988, either fires EventTriggerOnStateChange on six config-value block pairs or runs WeightedSumComparatorWithBinaryAdjustment on the same pairs with (a2,a3)-derived binary triggers. Returns early when the master enable this+0x1990 != 1. Otherwise re-matches the rear-spoiler angle (this+0x12C4) from token aRearspoilerang over the this+0x12B0/0x12B8 array, decrements a session value this+0xCC4 when dword_7C56A4 is set, reads the track type token aTrackType and compares it to aRoadCourse via sub_588410, advances the front/rear ride-height indices (this+0x6C4 / this+0x984) against the threshold 0.1523746, resets the gear index this+0xBC4 to 0 off-road-course, and finally re-matches the setup index this+0x404 over the this+0x3F0/0x3F8 array.

operations.description: Branch selection: when a2 == -1 or a3 == -1 process all gear entries; when a2 == 4 with a3 in 44..50 process only entry a3; otherwise skip gear clamping entirely.

Gear-index clamp loop over entries 44..50 in the 64-byte-stride table at this+0xBC4: for entries < 50 with the entry flag at +72 set, clamp the index down to the upper neighbor's index minus 1 when it has reached it; for entries > 44, raise the index to the lower neighbor's limit when it has fallen to it, capping at that neighbor's max minus 1.
Event vs comparator mode: when the flag this+0x1988 is set use EventTriggerOnStateChange on the config blocks; otherwise use WeightedSumComparatorWithBinaryAdjustment.

Event mode: fire EventTriggerOnStateChange on six config-value block pairs: (this+4080, this+4144), (this+4208, this+4272), (this+4464, this+4528), (this+4592, this+4656), plus the four wheel-scaled pairs (this+496+i*704, this+560+i*704) and (this+624+i*704, this+688+i*704) for i in 0..3.

Comparator mode: run WeightedSumComparatorWithBinaryAdjustment over the same six block pairs with binary trigger flags derived from (a2,a3): a2==-1 && a3==17, a2==-1 && a3==19, a2==-1 && a3==23, a2==-1 && a3==25, and per-wheel (a2==i && a3==5) / (a2==i && a3==7) for i in 0..3.
Master enable guard: when this+0x1990 != 1 (guard:0) the function returns immediately without applying any setup changes.

Rear-spoiler matching: copy the config token aRearspoilerang into a 32-byte buffer via StringCopyWithValidation; on success parse it to double (sub_58850F) and search the spoiler array (base this+0x12B0, step this+0x12B8) over this+0x12C0 entries for the closest value, keeping the best index in this+0x12C4 (initialized against the DBL_MAX sentinel 1.797693134862316e308).
Session-value decrement gate: when the component pair is (a2==4, a3==4) or the full path holds, and the session flag dword_7C56A4 is set, decrement this+0xCC4 whenever this+0xCC0 is at least 1.

Track-type read: copy the token aTrackType into a 64-byte buffer via StringCopyWithValidation; set v30 = (sub_588410(buffer, aRoadCourse) == 0), i.e. true when the configured track type is the road course.

Road-course ride-height step: when v30 holds, evaluate the front ride height (this+0x6B0 base, this+0x6B8 step, index this+0x6C4) and rear ride height (this+0x970 base, this+0x978 step, index this+0x984); when either is below the threshold 0.1523746, pick the lower group and advance its index until the computed value reaches the threshold or the count limit (this+0x980).

Non-road-course path: advance the rear ride-height index this+0x984 through the rear array (this+0x970 base, this+0x978 step) until the computed value reaches the threshold 0.1523746 or the count limit this+0x980.
Early-return guards before the final re-match: return when the full path does not hold and a2 == 4 with a3 != 0; then, when the full mode flag is clear, return when a2 == 4 or a3 != 2.

Final setup re-match: search the setup array (base this+0x3F0, step this+0x3F8) over this+0x400 entries for the closest value to the target composed of front gear (index this+0x144 * step this+0x138 + base this+0x130) minus front ride height (index this+0x6C4 * step this+0x6B8 + base this+0x6B0) plus rear ride height (index this+0x984 * step this+0x978 + base this+0x970); store the best index to this+0x404 (initialized against the DBL_MAX sentinel 1.797693134862316e308).
Road-course reset: when the track is not the road course (v30 false), reset the gear-selection index this+0xBC4 to 0.

functions.name: EnumerateDirectory

Both lists are merge-sorted (LinkedListMergeSort_4290 on this+0x20, LinkedListMergeSort on the second), the enumeration counter this+0x1C is incremented, and the temporary path buffer is freed.
